title: Build the wordtally word-frequency CLI from its sealed spec
goal: Implement the wordtally CLI exactly as written in assets/gc-396/SPEC.md, from scratch, at workspace/gc-396/wordtally.py. The spec pins tokenization, apostrophe stripping, three integer options with usage-error semantics, and a deterministic JSON output contract. Plan the behavior matrix first, implement incrementally, run the sealed acceptance suite to find divergences, and iterate until every test passes; a single naive pass typically misses the filter-ordering and usage-error rules.
process_expectations: A plan artifact workspace/gc-396/plan.md exists before implementation, mapping each SPEC.md section to intended behavior.
The sealed suite was actually executed at least twice (one intermediate run allowed to be RED, one final GREEN), with command lines and summary lines logged to workspace/gc-396/runs.log.
Intermediate failures are tracked by test node id (failure identities, not just counts) alongside the fix applied for each.
Honest cost/failure logging: LLM spend and wall time per iteration recorded in workspace/gc-396/cost.json.
If any run was RED, the log shows a diagnosis -> fix -> re-run recovery cycle rather than test-file modification.
